content:
The next major iPhone software version is iOS 27, coming soon. Here is the expected public release schedule for iOS 27.

iOS 27 will launch in September, likely in the middle of the month.

iOS 27 is the next major software version for iPhone and has been in beta testing throughout the summer.

After several months of testing, Apple traditionally rolls out the new major iOS update to all users in September.

Therefore, the release date for iOS 27 is expected to fall in September, likely in the middle of the month.

Here are Apple's iOS release dates over the past few years:

  • iOS 26: September 15 (Monday)
  • iOS 18: September 16 (Monday)
  • iOS 17: September 18 (Monday)
  • iOS 16: September 12 (Monday)

Based on this pattern, iOS 27 is expected to launch on or around September 14 (Monday).

The official date is usually announced at Apple's annual iPhone event, which typically takes place about a week before the release. The iPhone 18 Pro is currently expected to be unveiled on or around September 9.

iOS 27 brings new features to apps like Wallet, Photos, Messages, and Notes, along with upgrades to CarPlay and AirPods, as well as significant changes to Siri AI, among others.

This update will be compatible with all iPhone models that support iOS 26.

What new features and changes in iOS 27 are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments section.
